claims.text: meeting-notes-example.md@stage-1 1-9: title; Mục đích states the question (may a paid order be cancelled); attendees (PO, two developers, tester) and 20 minutes; line 9: paid orders cannot be cancelled from the app, the customer asks for a refund.

After the decision come Lý do (reason), Việc phải làm (a table with Việc, Ai, Khi nào; hiding the cancel button for paid orders is a task this sprint) and Câu chưa trả lời (refused shipped orders; PO will ask operations).
The notes' section headings (Quyết định, Lý do, Việc phải làm, Câu chưa trả lời) name topics rather than state content; each section is a few lines.
A busy reader may stop after the first lines, so a work document should open with its conclusion, decision or request, with background and reasons after it.

A statement heading helps a skimming reader more than a topic heading, most of all in longer documents; steps go in a numbered list and options compared on the same points in a table; paragraphs suit arguments.
The product owner is the person who decides what the team builds and in what order (wording as in management.l2.forecasting-with-velocity).

self_check.notes: Quotes meeting-notes-example.md@stage-1 1-9 verbatim. Notes use topic headings; lesson says so.
